ms.report:
A. Output: End-to-End Cross-Chain Workflow Design
What was delivered:
A complete end-to-end cross-chain workflow design for the ZK-Stables bridge covering lock → proof → mint/release and burn → proof → unlock flows. The design includes normal execution paths as well as failure scenarios such as chain reorgs, delayed finality, and relayer retries.
Acceptance criteria:
Architecture validated to meet all Milestone 1 requirements and define an integration-ready, non-custodial cross-chain workflow.
Evidence:
End-to-end workflow diagrams and explanations are documented in the Feasibility Report and System Architecture Blueprint:
https://github.com/dextrlabs-dev/ZK-Stables-USDC-USDT-Non-Custodial-Bridge/blob/main/ZK-Stables_USDCUSDT_Non_Custodial_Bridge_Architectural_Planning__Feasibility_Report__System_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
B. Output: Contract Interfaces & SDK Integration Surface
What was delivered:
Detailed definitions of contract interfaces, SDK function surfaces, wallet integration points, and relayer endpoints, enabling wallets, dApps, and external chains to integrate without custom forks or custodial assumptions.
Acceptance criteria:
Integration-ready design supporting wallets, dApps, and other chains without custom forks.
Evidence:
Contract responsibilities, SDK interfaces, wallet integration points, and relayer interaction flows are documented in the Architecture Blueprint section of the report:
https://github.com/dextrlabs-dev/ZK-Stables-USDC-USDT-Non-Custodial-Bridge/blob/main/ZK-Stables_USDCUSDT_Non_Custodial_Bridge_Architectural_Planning__Feasibility_Report__System_Architecture_Blueprint.pdf
C. Output: Risk Evaluation & Mitigation Analysis
What was delivered:
A comprehensive risk evaluation addressing chain reorgs, chain halts, proving latency, relayer failures, and privacy leakage risks, along with documented mitigation strategies such as finality thresholds, fallback relayers, and deterministic state machines.
Acceptance criteria:
Documented fallback str
